\begin{minipage}{0.95\linewidth}\footnotesize EN4 values use the salinity of EN4 with the circulation of the stated product, frozen at its record mean (Methods); pair A (own monthly circulation) and the frozen circulation give the EN4 rows of panels (a) and (f). Intervals are 95\% intervals of the bias-corrected trend test. A dagger marks an effective sample size at its floor of 3, where the interval is uninformative and the \(p\) value reads n.e. (not evaluated). n.s. marks \(p\ge 0.05\). Panel (c) gives no ratio of the reanalysis to EN4; the fixed-circulation ratio is not used in the text. The RG09 \citep{RoemmichGilsonArgoClimatology2019} rows cover 2005--2024 in the upper 2000 m only; the RG09 and EN4 segments differ in longitude (RG09 70 points, EN4 74 points) and in row latitude (34.5\(^\circ\)S and 34.0\(^\circ\)S). In panel (d) the standard-deviation ratio is the standard deviation of the reanalysis anomalies over that of SAMBA, with an approximate F interval; the \(p\) values use the effective sample size of each pair.\end{minipage}
